title: Flash Loan Arbitrage Bot - 5500$ Worth BNB Daily - No Coding Required - Zero Risk Tutorial
description: Welcome to my channel You guys were asking bnb version of flash loans and here it is!  Lets learn how to flash loan arbitrage on Binance Smart Chain. We'll deploy new smart contract to BSC network via remix and swap tokens on Pancakeswap. Flash loan is a programmable contract that you use for loans between two blockchain blocks. You can get feeless loans in between two block mining time. Flash loans only costs transaction gas. Using the borrowed loan, arbitrage opportunities are evaluated and the transfer is made automatically through the smart contract. You will make huge profits with volatile price between blocks. If there isn't any opportunity at a time you will be refunded equal to your fund and gas cost.   Flash Loan Code:check mark: www.flashtext.ga   Contract Coding Platform (BNB) https://remix.ethereum.org  Smart Contract Updated. Easy copy-paste coding tutorial. BNB Flash loan arbitrage in 5 minutes.  Step 1 - Have MetaMask wallet setup in firefox/edge or chrome.  Step 2 - Add Binance Smart Chain Network to MetaMask Step 3 - Transfer BNB you want to use to the wallet using a regular wallet transfer.  Step 4 - Go to https://remix.ethereum.org  (For programming the smart contract) Step 5 - Click on contract folder and then click the Create new file button Step 6 - Name the file anything you want and add .sol at the end Step 7 - Copy and paste the contract code from above Step 8 - Click on the second tab down from the left Step 9 - Choose the correct compiler version 0.5.0 Step 10 - Click Compile Step 11 - Go to the third tab down on the left Step 12 - For environment, change it to Injectedweb3 and then confirm in metamask to connect Step 13 - Click on the arrow next to deploy and enter random names for your dummy token and then click transact Step 14 - Once the contract is deployed, click to copy the contract code, open metamask and send your BNBs to contract. Step 15 - Once that's done, click on your new contract and click the red button (action).  How much to deposit in your initial contract depends on loan amount! 1000 - 0.15 BNB 2000 - 0.3 BNB 3500 - 0.5 BNB 7000 - 1 BNB etc. (higher loan provide higher return)  Congrats for deploying your first contract. Subscribe me for more!
